create.name: Institute of Noetic Sciences
create.bio:
The Institute of Noetic Sciences, usually called IONS, is a non-profit research centre in Novato, California, founded in 1973 by the Apollo 14 astronaut Edgar Mitchell after a profound personal experience of discovery. Its work sits where scientific method meets direct inner experience: its own scientists run laboratory studies on meditation, intuition, channelling, intention and other experiences that mainstream research tends to pass over, and publish the results.

Alongside the research, IONS offers an experiential side for the public. Most of it is online: a free e-course introducing noetic topics, free live webinars with its scientists and guests, and paid self-paced courses, among them a nine-module course on working with the wandering mind led by neuroscientist Arnaud Delorme. Members give on a sliding scale and in return join a worldwide community, with access to a large library of recorded talks and conference sessions, members-only gatherings and discounts on programmes and conferences. The institute also supports a network of community groups, and it shares its talks and research explainers on YouTube.

courses.title: IONS Membership
courses.description: Sliding-scale membership that funds the institute's research. Members can watch a library of recorded webinars and conference talks, join members-only online gatherings, and receive discounts and early access to programmes and conferences.
courses.price: CORE: annual gift of $60 to $999 or monthly gift of $10 to $83; CIRCLE: annual gift of $1,000 or more or monthly gift of $84 or more

courses.title: Taming the Wandering Mind: Cultivating Clarity and Focus
courses.description: A self-paced online course in nine modules with neuroscientist Arnaud Delorme on how attention moves and how to work with a wandering mind. Each module closes with a guided practice drawn from meditation and contemplative traditions.

free_resources.title: Noetics 101: The Science and Experience of Interconnection
free_resources.description: A free e-course of fifteen short modules sent every other day over a month. Each one introduces a noetic topic such as intuition, intention or meditation, with exercises to try and suggestions for further reading.

free_resources.title: ConnectIONS Live
free_resources.description: Free online webinars, held regularly, in which IONS scientists and guest speakers present research and practices, followed by questions from the audience.
